survey_points: PalletPoseNode::on_pair already extracts every target-class detection in extract_detection_candidates, which stores source_index as that detection's index in the Detection2DArray. select_detection (default highest_confidence) returns one DetectionCandidate by value and the other candidates are discarded. estimate_pose_chamfer_v3_2 runs once, on that candidate only. publish_ok_diagnostics emits chamfer_cost_m, plane_inlier_ratio, n_face_points, input_rgb_stamp, and input_depth_stamp; publish_failure_diagnostics emits failure_reason plus the same two stamps. Neither status lists the unselected source indexes. Those stamps are this synced pair's det_msg->header.stamp and depth_msg->header.stamp. Publishing the unused source indexes on that same DiagnosticArray is a few KeyValue strings. Calling estimate_pose_chamfer_v3_2 once per extra detection would repeat the chamfer search below. If select_detection returns empty, on_pair returns before any diagnostic is published.

Measured pose latency is that single estimate_pose_chamfer_v3_2. two_stage_chamfer_search_v2 always runs: free coarse is 21 yaw x 31 x 31 = 20181 (±10 deg at 1 deg, ±0.15 m at 0.01 m) and free fine is 13 x 25 x 25 = 8125 (±1.2 deg at 0.2 deg, ±0.012 m at 0.001 m). two_stage_chamfer_search_v2_with_prior runs unless lambda_eff <= lambda_floor 0.05. confidence is clamp((0.020 - free_cost) / 0.014, 0, 1) and lambda_eff is prior_lambda 3.0 times (1 - confidence), so the prior is skipped only when the free chamfer cost is about 0.00623 m or lower. Prior coarse is 21 x 21 x 21 = 9261 (±0.10 m at 0.01 m, same 21 yaw steps) plus another 8125 fine evaluations. The common frame is 45692 chamfer_cost_from_rotated evaluations, plus one seed chamfer_cost_v2 before each stage, two choose_pi_ambiguous_pose costs, one anchor chamfer_cost_v2, and one data-only chamfer_cost_v2 after the prior search. OpenMP schedule(static) over the flattened index does not reduce that count.

Each of those evaluations is O(N log N). Default contour_spacing_m 0.03 builds N=182 contour points (1.20 x 0.14 m outer face plus two 0.47 x 0.10 m pockets), cached in cached_prototype. rotate_proto_into is cached once per theta in thread-local ChamferTls. chamfer_cost_from_rotated still assigns tls.translated = rotated (N x 2) and adds tx, ty on every translation, bilinear-samples all N distances from the float distance image, assign-copies them into a std::vector, and std::sorts the whole vector even though trim_fraction 0.10 sums only ceil(0.9*N). The bilinear loop reads column-major points(i, 0) and points(i, 1).

Before the grid, still once per posed detection: depth_image_to_meters convertTo-copies the whole depth frame to CV_32FC1; sample_face_points scans every depth pixel (camera.yaml depth 640x480) with a K_inv ray, an SE3 into RGB, and a lookup in a full 1920x1080 mask that build_bbox_mask zero-fills and erodes, then copies accepted points row by row into an Eigen matrix; rasterize_points_to_mask pads by padding_m 0.80 at resolution_m 0.005, so a 1.20 x 0.14 m face is about 561 x 349 pixels; close_mask clones that mask, runs an elliptical close and connectedComponentsWithStats; compute_distance_transform_v2 calls cv::distanceTransform with DIST_L2 and DIST_MASK_PRECISE and convertTo to CV_32FC1. ransac_plane_fit (up to ransac_iters 100) allocates a residual array and a bool mask each iteration, and the inliers are copied again into plane_points_3d before project_points_to_plane_2d. These passes are smaller than the 45692-evaluation grid and run only for the candidate select_detection already chose.

Stage 1 is a separate process and is not where deferred indexes are published. rtdetr_detector_node defaults to backend mock, which skips inference copies. detector.yaml and full_pipeline.launch.py set backend tensorrt at input 640. On that path image_to_rgb copies msg.data, preprocess resizes to 640x640 and builds a float32 CHW array, and TensorRTBackend copies into pinned host memory, memcpy HtoD, then copies labels, boxes, and scores back. That host traffic is on the pipeline before message_filters delivers the pair to on_pair. Deferred diagnostic KeyValues do not change it.
